item.title: It's Here! GTA 6 Launches Today, 13 Years After GTA 5
item.description:
🎮 It's Here! GTA 6 Launches Today, 13 Years After GTA 5
Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto VI launches today, Thursday, November 19. Rockstar says it unlocks at midnight local time in each region, so some countries get it hours before others. It is the first new main GTA game since GTA V came out in 2013.
🔹 It is out on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. There is no PC version yet. The standard edition costs $80 and the Ultimate Edition costs $100. 🔹 Sony and Microsoft both say it is the most pre-ordered game in the history of their digital stores. 🔹 The game is set in Vice City and the state of Leonida, inspired by Miami and Florida. Its two main characters are Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, the series' first female lead.
💬 Are you playing GTA 6 this week? 👇
Sources: Rockstar Games, ABC News, Forbes
#GlobalEye #GTA6 #GrandTheftAuto #RockstarGames #Gaming #PS5

item.title: Surprise Hint! Trump Says He May Meet Kim Jong Un in China
item.description:
🇺🇸🇰🇵 Surprise Hint! Trump Says He May Meet Kim Jong Un in China
US President Donald Trump said on Monday, November 16, that he may meet North Korean leader Kim Jong Un during his trip to China. Speaking to reporters at the White House before leaving for Asia, he said: "He may come. I don't know. That's up to President Xi."
🔹 Trump is due to meet China's Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China. 🔹 There are no known plans for a meeting yet. North Korea is not an APEC member, and South Korea's foreign minister said Kim was unlikely to attend. 🔹 Trump and Kim met three times during Trump's first term: in Singapore (2018), Hanoi (2019) and at the Korean border village of Panmunjom (2019).
💬 Do you think a fourth Trump-Kim meeting will happen? 👇
Sources: ABC News, Yonhap
#GlobalEye #Trump #KimJongUn #NorthKorea #China #APEC

item.title: Chip Crackdown! US Moves to Block China's Remote Access to AI Chips
item.description:
💻 Chip Crackdown! US Moves to Block China's Remote Access to AI Chips
The US Commerce Department announced a new rule on Monday, November 16, to stop Chinese companies from using advanced American AI chips remotely through data centers in other countries. Selling these chips directly to China already needs a US licence.
🔹 Data centers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and Brazil will now need a US licence to receive advanced AI chips from Nvidia and other US makers. US-based companies operating there are exempt. 🔹 Exporters and data center operators must check that no company from China or other restricted countries is controlling or using the computing power, including through middlemen. 🔹 The move comes days after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepped down over reports linking him to a woman US officials reportedly suspected of being a Chinese operative. Nvidia reports its earnings on Tuesday.
💬 Will this rule really stop AI chips from reaching China? 👇
Sources: NPR, Bloomberg
#GlobalEye #Nvidia #AIChips #China #USA #TechNews

item.title: Heaviest Home Loss! Portugal Crushed 4-1 by Denmark in First Game Without Ronaldo
item.description:
⚽ Heaviest Home Loss! Portugal Crushed 4-1 by Denmark in First Game Without Ronaldo
Denmark beat Portugal 4-1 in Braga on Saturday in the UEFA Nations League. It was Portugal's first match since Cristiano Ronaldo announced his international retirement last week.
🔹 Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg scored a penalty before half-time, Rasmus Hojlund scored twice early in the second half, and Joachim Andersen added a header. Bernardo Silva scored late for Portugal. 🔹 ESPN says it is Portugal's heaviest home defeat in a competitive match. 🔹 Portugal are already in the quarter-finals but must avoid defeat against Wales on Tuesday to win the group.
💬 Can Portugal bounce back without Ronaldo? 👇
Sources: ESPN, BBC Sport
#GlobalEye #Football #NationsLeague #Portugal #Denmark #Ronaldo #Hojlund

item.title: History Made! SpaceX Catches Starship With Tower Arms After 14 Orbits
item.description:
🚀 History Made: SpaceX Catches Starship With Tower Arms After 14 Orbits
SpaceX caught its Starship spacecraft with the giant arms of its launch tower at Starbase, Texas, on Saturday. It is the first time a Starship has been caught after returning from space. The ship landed about 22 hours after it took off on Friday.
🔹 On its 15th test flight, Starship circled Earth 14 times at about 265 km (165 miles) up and released 26 Starlink satellites. 🔹 The Super Heavy booster did not come back as planned. Its engines stopped too early and it was destroyed over the Gulf of Mexico. SpaceX is investigating. 🔹 Catching rockets is key to reusing them. NASA plans to use Starship as a Moon lander. NASA chief Jared Isaacman said: "It was almost magic."
💬 Would you like to travel to space one day? 👇
Sources: AP, CNN, CNBC
#GlobalEye #SpaceX #Starship #ElonMusk #Space #NASA

item.title: Nvidia Scandal Grows! US Commerce Chief Lutnick Agrees to Testify Before Senate
item.description:
💻 Nvidia Scandal Grows: US Commerce Chief Lutnick Agrees to Testify Before Senate
US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick has agreed to appear before the Senate Banking Committee, CNN and CBS News reported on Friday. The committee is looking at how advanced Nvidia AI chips may have reached China, and why the US did not act sooner.
🔹 Committee chairman Senator Tim Scott asked Lutnick to testify on December 10. A source said the details are still being worked out. 🔹 The probe centres on Megaspeed, a Singapore-based Nvidia customer that US officials suspect of helping Chinese firms get around chip export limits. China rejects the spying claims linked to the case. 🔹 Lawmakers have also asked former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned this week, to testify in early December, and warned they could use subpoenas.
💬 Should the US be stricter about selling AI chips to China? 👇
Sources: CNN, CBS News, CNBC
#GlobalEye #Nvidia #Lutnick #AIChips #China #TechNews

item.title: Massive Attack! Ukraine Fires Nearly 1,200 Drones at Russia Overnight
item.description:
⚠️ Ukraine Fires Nearly 1,200 Drones at Russia Overnight
Ukraine launched almost 1,200 drones at Russia overnight from Thursday to Friday, one of its biggest air attacks since the full-scale war began nearly five years ago. Russia's Defence Ministry said its air defences shot down 1,198 drones over more than 15 regions.
🔹 Russian officials reported deaths. At least four workers were killed in an industrial area in the Volgograd region, the regional governor said. 🔹 Moscow's mayor said 467 drones were heading for the capital. Russia also attacked Ukraine overnight; Ukrainian officials said at least two people were killed in Odesa. 🔹 The attack came after two days of US-led talks in Abu Dhabi. US envoys say Europe will join the next round of peace talks.
💬 Do you think the peace talks can stop the war? 👇
Sources: AP, Al Jazeera, AFP
#GlobalEye #Ukraine #Russia #Drones #UkraineWar #WorldNews

item.title: Big Homecoming! Pope Leo Returns to the Peru City He Led as Bishop
item.description:
🙏 Pope Leo Returns to the Peru City He Led as Bishop
Pope Leo XIV arrived in Chiclayo, Peru, on Friday for an outdoor Mass in the city where he served as bishop for eight years. Local officials said up to 1 million people could attend.
🔹 Before becoming pope, Leo (born Robert Prevost in Chicago) worked in Peru for about 20 years as a missionary priest and bishop. 🔹 In Lima on Wednesday, about 3 million people came out to see him, the biggest crowd of his papacy so far, Reuters reported. 🔹 Peru is the last stop of his 12-day South America trip, after Argentina and Uruguay. He stays in the Chiclayo area until Sunday.
💬 Have you ever seen the Pope in person? 👇
Sources: Reuters, AP

item.title: Shock Collapse! India All Out for 89 as New Zealand Win by 244 Runs
item.description:
🏏 India All Out for 89 as New Zealand Win by 244 Runs
New Zealand beat India by 244 runs in the fourth ODI at Bay Oval, Mount Maunganui, on Friday. New Zealand made 333, and India were bowled out for just 89 in reply.
🔹 Fast bowler Matt Henry took 6 wickets for 27 runs. Reuters reported he took three wickets in his first over, including Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli. 🔹 Will Young scored 125 from 108 balls, his fifth ODI hundred. 🔹 India still lead the five-match series 2-1 (the third match was washed out by rain). The last match is on Sunday at the same ground.
💬 What went wrong for India today? 👇
Sources: Al Jazeera, Reuters, ESPNcricinfo

item.title: Cuba Warning! Trump Says He Wants to Get Cuba Done Before Leaving Office
item.description:
🌎 Trump Says He Wants to "Get Cuba Done" Before Leaving Office
US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that he wants to "get Cuba done" before he leaves office in 2029. Speaking in a radio interview with host Hugh Hewitt, he said he would consider using military force against Cuba and that his team is "watching it very closely."
🔹 Politico reported this is the first time Trump has given a timeline for possible action on Cuba. 🔹 Trump said Secretary of State Marco Rubio, whose parents are from Cuba, "would love to do it." 🔹 Since January, the US has blocked most oil shipments to Cuba, which has led to blackouts and food and fuel shortages. Cuban officials have said the island is ready for any attack.
💬 What do you think will happen next between the US and Cuba? 👇
Sources: Al Jazeera, Politico, The Hill
#GlobalEye #Cuba #USA #Trump #WorldNews #Politics

item.title: Tensions Rise! Iran Says It Hit a US Radar in Bahrain
item.description:
⚠️ Iran Says It Hit a US Radar in Bahrain
Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) said on Friday that they targeted and destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain. Iran's state news agency IRNA reported the statement. AP and Al Jazeera said the claim could not be independently verified, and the US and Bahrain did not comment straight away.
🔹 The IRGC said it was a reply to an attack on a telecom tower in Sirik, a port city in southern Iran, on Thursday. 🔹 According to Reuters, it is Iran's first claimed attack on US military assets in a Gulf country since early September. 🔹 Bahrain hosts the headquarters of the US Navy's Fifth Fleet. The IRGC warned it is ready to act again.
💬 Do you think talks can stop the tension from growing? 👇
Sources: AP, Al Jazeera, Reuters
#GlobalEye #Iran #Bahrain #USA #MiddleEast #WorldNews

item.title: Global Outage! Microsoft Outlook and Teams Go Down for 5+ Hours
item.description:
💻 Microsoft Outlook and Teams down for hours
A major Microsoft 365 outage disrupted Outlook email, Teams and other Microsoft services for more than five hours on Thursday, Reuters reported. Problems began around 12:30 p.m. US Eastern time, and Microsoft said users in any region could be affected.
🔹 Problem reports for Outlook on Downdetector peaked at more than 138,000, according to Reuters. 🔹 Microsoft said a number of servers became unexpectedly unavailable because of elevated load, mainly hitting Exchange Online email. 🔹 Microsoft said it was returning servers to service and moving traffic, and warned that recovery would be gradual as users reconnect.
💬 Were you affected by the Microsoft outage? 👇
Sources: Reuters, ABC News
#GlobalEye #Microsoft #Outlook #Teams #Outage #Tech
